source: index.html (hp, damage, weapon) and the main line's reading of the code; scripts/make_roster_json.py

match_rules.mode: 1 v 1 in the page (4 v 4 planned for rooms)
match_rules.weather: rain x0.9 attack, storm x0.9 attack and +1.5 wind, snow x0.5 movement, fog and clear no change (js/weather.js), seeded by match seed and round
match_rules.energy: each successful throw adds 1 pip, 3 pips arm the ultimate, at most 2 ultimates per match, ultimate damage is capped at 1.5 x the normal hit on one unit (the bride and the hunchback exceed it in their own ways)
match_rules.head_shot: crit multiplier and a stun on the top quarter of the body near the middle

heroes.name: Skeleton Spearman
heroes.normal_attack: Javelin, bleeds (2 per round start, 2 rounds), frost curse on hit (target attacks 15 percent weaker for its next 2 throws: the code multiplies by 0.85)
heroes.ultimate: Triple javelin: each carries 1.5 x normal / 3, +5 percent per earlier hit, the third of three is a head crit

heroes.name: Pumpkin Wizard
heroes.ultimate: Big pumpkin blast: 1.5 x normal splash within 234 px of the landing point, 13 flames burn
heroes.special: Lobbed shell with splash ultimate; damage 24 is the same as the skeleton (the bride 25 and the knight total 30 are higher)

heroes.name: Bat-cat Assassin
heroes.normal_attack: One shuriken, slows the target's next move
heroes.ultimate: Shuriken rain: 5 shurikens, each 1.5 x normal / 5

heroes.name: Pumpkin Guard
heroes.normal_attack: Thrown small shield bounces 1 to 6 times (die), total damage shared
heroes.ultimate: Hidden shield points (js/knight_ult.js): up to 3 hidden blocks (A, B, C) marked on remembered enemy paths while defending, each stops one of the next enemy throws that crosses it; wired in the page
heroes.special: Floating shield (coffin) over its own head on a slight arc: can give up the attack to place it
provisional: dmg 30 is the TOTAL over the bounces

heroes.name: Necromancer
heroes.normal_attack: Purple flame, flat quick trajectory. The planned burn status (2 per round for 3 rounds) is NOT implemented in the page: the flame deals its direct damage only
heroes.ultimate: Soul-fire volley: 3 flames 11.5 each, 0.15 s apart, burn once
heroes.special: Three circling ghost fires are its energy pips

heroes.name: Ghost Bride
heroes.normal_attack: Sound wave 105 px half width, hits only the aimed unit, stepped falloff 100/75/50 percent at 40/75/105 px, counts where it lands, poison on hit
heroes.ultimate: Bat swarm: a hit inside 40 px calls a swarm on every enemy for 25 x 1.3 = 32.5, shield cannot stop it (1v1 total 57.5 at full falloff)
heroes.special: Aim precision matters more than for any other hero
heroes.art: windup, late-charge (old wide-mouth frame), release, hit; expression change is small

heroes.name: Bell-tower Hunchback
heroes.normal_attack: Giant spinning axe, bleeds, knockback 50 px on a surviving direct hit (kept inside its zone)
heroes.ultimate: Boomerang axe: pierces every unit on the way out (21 each, shields do not stop it), returns to the first unit hit for 31.5 only if the outbound pass hit someone (1v1 total 52.5)
heroes.special: Highest HP of the roster except the knight
heroes.art: windup and hit done; release uses the empty-handed stance (a clean throw frame is still missing)

heroes.name: Ghost Nun
heroes.normal_attack: Spinning silver cross wrapped in black smoke, no status
heroes.ultimate: Silver cross strike: two contacts at 0.5 x normal each (11 + 11 = 22 total, provisional), one touched enemy gets an electric stun (next turn shortened to 7 s)
heroes.special: HP and damage are PROVISIONAL guesses of the main line (the owner gave no numbers)
heroes.art: empty-handed idle, idle2, windup, late charge, release, hit; silver cross is a separate picture
